notes: Fixed dock position jumping, added Bluetooth device search, improved system tray icons, and added automatic updates.

releases.title: Dock Stability, Bluetooth Discovery & Auto-Updates
changes: Fixed the dock briefly jumping upward when opening or closing apps.
All background apps now appear properly in the system tray, and double-clicking the tray icon closes the popup.
Added live device search in the Bluetooth menu to find nearby headphones, speakers, and accessories.
Fixed Storage free space display on first open and added automatic updates with the new Changelog tab.

releases.title: App Icon & License Checkout
changes: Updated the NexBar app icon with the new metallic N design.
Fixed the Buy button in Settings so it opens the license checkout page directly in your browser.
Improved taskbar restoration when closing or uninstalling NexBar.

releases.title: Liquid Glass & Smart Widgets
changes: Added Liquid Glass dock styling and smooth icon magnification.
Added Focus timer, Screen Time, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, and AI usage widgets.
